flow3d_label: Titanium Alloy Ti Al V IMI 318 Mills data
source: Material values transcribed from a local FLOW-3D case input for reproducibility testing.
real_material_test_note: ARM C of the t2_nist195 transient attribution (2026-08-06). Identical to ti64_tv3520 except vaporization_temperature_k 3520 -> 3425 K, the low edge of the +-~95 K (1 sigma) band the tv1 scan reported. Lowering Tv stiffens the saturation curve and raises recoil at a given temperature, so this bounds how much of the missed drilling transient the vaporization calibration could account for while staying inside its own anchor.
